brief:
Gaza's health ministry warned that the territory's medical system stands on the brink of complete collapse amid an ongoing blockade preventing fuel, medicines, and medical supplies from entering, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry said hospitals now face the imminent danger of shutdown as shortages intensify across the healthcare sector.

The blockade has cut off fuel, medicines, and medical equipment needed to keep hospitals running. Health officials have made repeated appeals for access to these supplies.

title: Gaza health ministry warns hospitals face total collapse
